business.description: Esquire Money Guarantees Limited earns revenue from consultancy charges and dividend income. The company holds non-current investments in shares and has inventories of finished goods.

products.name: Consultancy Services
products.note: Revenue from operations consists solely of consultancy charges of Rs 8.78 lakh in FY2026.

other_notable: Revenue from operations: Rs 8.78 lakh (FY2026) vs Rs 8.33 lakh (FY2025)
Loss for the year: Rs 56.37 lakh (FY2026) vs Rs 3.00 lakh (FY2025)
Significant increase in other expenses due to BSE/SEBI fine & penalty of Rs 45.94 lakh in FY2026
Non-current investments decreased from Rs 397.79 lakh to Rs 323.19 lakh
Cash and cash equivalents decreased from Rs 11.72 lakh to Rs 5.30 lakh
No depreciation provided on fixed assets during the year
Company continues to provide for income tax at old rates based on MAT credit entitlement
No shares held by any shareholder holding more than 5% as per Note 2(C)
